rivalry.rationale: No derma-specific brand shares exist, but the visible competitive cluster is dense and the pull is strong: the segment grew +13% YoY (2024, Euromonitor, HIGH) on an actives race (PDRN, exosomes, peptides), and the named players span both majors and indies — AmorePacific runs Aestura and Illiyoon, LG H&H is present, and APR (Medicube) is a listed indie, alongside Dr.Jart+ and Dr. Melaxin. Double-digit growth attracting both conglomerate derma lines and funded indies into an actives arms race reads as HIGH rivalry, though the rating rests on player visibility rather than measured shares.
evidence: config/corridor.yaml:conduits (Aestura, Illiyoon, Medicube, Dr.Jart+, Dr. Melaxin)

buyer_power.rationale: Derma reaches consumers through the same concentrated H&B retail (Olive Young) and online channels as skincare, plus pharmacy/clinic-adjacent routes, so channel power is present. No derma-specific channel-share or margin DataPoint exists, so the level is held at MEDIUM on structural inference.
buyer_power.research_needed: KR dermocosmetics channel mix and margins incl. pharmacy/clinic (euromonitor_passport)

supplier_power.rationale: Korea's ODM base (Cosmax, Kolmar, Cosmecca) extends into actives-heavy derma formulation, keeping the make outsourced and switchable and supplier leverage low overall. The one caveat: the frontier actives driving the segment (PDRN, exosomes, peptides) can concentrate around specialised ingredient/IP suppliers, which could raise supplier power at the premium edge — but the repo has no DataPoint isolating that, so the base reading stays LOW.
evidence: segments/dermocosmetics.json:KR growth note (PDRN, exosomes, peptides as actives)
supplier_power.research_needed: Whether frontier-actives (PDRN/exosome) supply is concentrated enough to lift supplier power (tavily, euromonitor_passport)

new_entrant_threat.rationale: Cosmeceutical/derma positioning leans on efficacy claims that fall under MFDS functional-cosmetic approval — a higher regulatory bar than plain skincare — which restrains entry. Offsetting it, APR/Medicube shows a listed indie can scale a derma brand fast off the ODM base. The two forces net to MEDIUM.

substitutes.rationale: The natural adjacency is aesthetic-clinic procedures and injectables (the same PDRN/exosome science originates there), but the repo holds no DataPoint measuring substitution between dermocosmetics and procedures. Left unrated per the grounding rules.
substitutes.research_needed: Substitution evidence between derma cosmetics and aesthetic/clinic procedures in KR (euromonitor_passport, tavily)

overall.rationale: The fastest-growing KR segment on file (+13%, HIGH) with an active innovation frontier and low supplier power — genuinely dynamic — but sizing is definitionally unresolved (Korean sources ~4x apart) and the functional-cosmetic entry bar plus concentrated retail temper attractiveness. Strongest read is as a brand-incubation and corridor-export segment rather than a clean domestic-share play.

rivalry.rationale: Derma/actives is India's hottest skincare fight. Domestic D2C is proven and consolidating — Minimalist reached Rs347cr revenue FY24 (+89% YoY) and was acquired by HUL at ~8.5x (~US$350mn), the benchmark derma-D2C exit — while the masstige-derma tier is the fastest-growing India cut on file (+14.6% CAGR). On top sit incumbents (Cetaphil, Skinshine) and an incoming K-derma import wave (Medicube, Aestura, Illiyoon on Nykaa/Tira). Multiple funded challengers, active M&A, and imports converging on one lane is HIGH rivalry.
evidence: segments/dermocosmetics.json:IN revenue Minimalist Rs347cr FY24 (+89%) + HUL 8.5x acquisition
segments/dermocosmetics.json:IN Expert Market Research masstige derma +14.6% CAGR

buyer_power.rationale: Buyer power is elevated by conduit concentration specific to derma: Nykaa is effectively the exclusive gateway for the K-derma wave (Medicube omnichannel launch, Illiyoon exclusive, Aestura), and its K-beauty GMV grew +60% YoY (Q3 2025) — the platform sits astride the segment's fastest-growing supply. Add the concentrated q-commerce rail and standard commissions/MRP margins, and channel buyers hold strong leverage over derma brands.
evidence: config/corridor.yaml:conduits (Nykaa exclusive K-derma: Illiyoon, Aestura; Medicube)
segments/dermocosmetics.json:IN Nykaa K-beauty GMV +60% YoY Q3 2025 (MEDIUM) [CORRIDOR]

supplier_power.rationale: Domestic derma D2C uses the same commoditised contract-manufacturing base as skincare (Gorgeous Cosmos / IndiaMART CMs; Galaxy Surfactants and Fine Organics for actives/surfactants), so suppliers hold little power over Indian brand owners. For imported K-derma the balance inverts — the brand depends on the Korean ODM/owner plus CDSCO clearance — so supplier power is MEDIUM specifically on the corridor-import lane.

new_entrant_threat.rationale: Derma is the most-funded and most-imitated lane: the Minimalist exit set a benchmark that pulls capital in, masstige derma is growing +14.6%, and the house-of-brands model spins up derma sub-brands cheaply (Innovist's Chemist at Play) on commoditised CM. K-derma owners are also entering directly (APR launched Medicube; AmorePacific brought Illiyoon). The import lane carries CDSCO/BIS friction (MEDIUM there), but domestic and direct-K entry are both wide open.

substitutes.rationale: P&S scopes India dermacosmetics as Rx-adjacent (acne, psoriasis, scars), which points to dermatologist prescriptions and clinic treatment as the natural substitute — but no DataPoint measures that substitution flow, so the force is left unrated.
substitutes.research_needed: Substitution evidence: OTC dermocosmetics vs dermatologist Rx / clinic procedures in India (tavily, euromonitor_passport)

overall.rationale: The corridor's highest-conviction whitespace — mid-price derma K-beauty into Tier 2/3 — and the most attractive of the three IN reads on demand: double-digit growth, a proven exit multiple, and confirmed corridor pull (Nykaa K-beauty GMV +60%, Medicube/Illiyoon/Aestura launching). Attractiveness is real but bounded by HIGH rivalry, HIGH buyer power (Nykaa's derma gatekeeping), and a genuinely unresolved ~7x sizing spread. Entry logic favours the corridor-import / partner-with-conduit route the whitespace itself describes.
